technology_name: Freeze Preservation of Sugarcane Juice with Natural Additives
institution: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Research Centre, Kannur
problem_solved: Rapid spoilage and short shelf life of fresh sugarcane juice
description: This preservation method extends the usability of sugarcane juice by incorporating natural additives that help reduce oxidation and microbial deterioration during storage. The process is designed to retain the colour and taste characteristics of the juice while improving storage stability. Herbal additives may also be incorporated to provide additional value to the final product.
applications:
Sugarcane juice processing and beverage manufacturing companies
Functional and health drink product enterprises
Food preservation and natural ingredient manufacturers
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and agro-processing units
Retail beverage brands and ready-to-serve drink producers
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
